summary: Maris-Tech Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 11, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq conditional compliance determination regarding the minimum stockholders' equity requirement. The company had been notified of non-compliance on May 22, 2026, and subsequently demonstrated compliance via a Form 6-K filed June 10, 2026. Nasdaq will monitor compliance, and failure to maintain it at the interim financials filing for the six months ending June 30, 2026, may lead to delisting proceedings. No price per share, premium, or other deal terms are stated. Watch for potential delisting if equity falls below $2.5 million threshold.
